name: RTX 3090 / RTX 4090 FP16/BF16 unlock (next boot)
hostNote: PowOS x86_64/rpm-ostree GPU host; gpu-195 has two RTX 3090s. The opt-in Ada build also supports desktop RTX 4090 (2684).
purpose: Pinned Ampere or Ada upstream profile, built for the exact host kernel and loaded from initramfs before NVIDIA. The CLI validates PCI targets; Blackwell and experimental Ada IDs are rejected. Enable/disable affect a later boot only; never reboot or live-load a module.
unbounded: Kernel module, no userspace daemon. Build cache and rootless builder image only; no ongoing GPU workload.
decide: Removal takes effect after a separately requested reboot. Rebuild for a new kernel before updating: the RPM depends on the exact kernel-core-uname-r. Local initramfs regeneration remains enabled because other packages may need it.
